text: Agreed, and your 2:28am screenshot shows exactly the bug: 'Scanning' with a green dot while its progress had been frozen at 70 of 10,691 for 9 minutes, and a bets count from a dead run. Plan (TCL79): (1) red banner + greyed tiles when the phone can't reach GitHub or its last read is over 20 s old; (2) engine silent 30 s = amber, 2 min = red, and progress frozen 90 s = STALLED, never a green 'Scanning'; (3) every bet shows the age of its Novig price and fair odds; bets past the limits (Novig price 5 min, fair odds 20 min, or from a dead run) leave the main list into 'Show old bets' and can't be bet from there. Building it right after the current release goes out.
